items.title: Secret police files released in Hungary, 37 years after fall of communism

sentences.en: Secret police files released in Hungary, 37 years after fall of communism.
sentences.zh: 匈牙利在共产主义垮台37年后公布的秘密警察档案。

sentences.en: Critics say the move comes too late, that the files themselves are incomplete, and the move risks sowing division and causing unnecessary anguish.
sentences.zh: 批评人士说，此举来得太晚，文件本身不完整，此举有可能导致分裂并造成不必要的痛苦。

items.title: ANC faces anger over poor services as South Africans vote in local elections

sentences.en: ANC faces anger over poor services as South Africans vote in local elections.
sentences.zh: 随着南非人在地方选举中投票，非国大面临着对糟糕服务的愤怒。

sentences.en: Party expected to get less than a third of the vote amid frustration over water outages and power cuts The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 由于对停水和停电的沮丧情绪，该党预计将获得不到三分之一的选票。由于选民对停水、停电和基础设施崩溃深感不满，他们前往投票站投票，非洲人国民大会(African National Congress)周三将在南非地方选举中取得令人沮丧的结果。

sentences.en: The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊·曼德拉（ Nelson Mandela ）于1994年在种族隔离结束时作为南非第一位黑人总统领导的前解放运动仍然可能是最大的政党。

sentences.en: However, polls showed it getting less than a third of the vote, down from 45.6% at the last municipal elections in 2021 and 40.2% in 2024’s national elections .
sentences.zh: 然而，民意调查显示，它获得的选票不到三分之一，低于2021年上次市政选举的45.6%和2024年全国选举的40.2%。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Iran unveils ‘We will kill Trump’ banner – but US president may now be tempted to resume bombing

sentences.en: Iran unveils ‘We will kill Trump’ banner – but US president may now be tempted to resume bombing.
sentences.zh: 伊朗公布了“我们将杀死特朗普”的旗帜，但美国总统现在可能很想恢复轰炸。

sentences.en: Iran celebrates its claimed role in ‘regime change’ amid pressure on Trump to ‘finish the job’ with attack US midterms live – latest updates Iran this week unveiled a huge billboard and banners over Enqelab Square in central Tehran.
sentences.zh: 伊朗庆祝其在“政权更迭”中所宣称的作用，特朗普面临着通过现场直播攻击美国“完成工作”的压力。伊朗本周在德黑兰市中心的恩克拉布广场（ Enqelab Square ）上发布了一个巨大的广告牌和横幅。

sentences.en: The billboard pledged in English: “We will kill Trump” – elevating the degree of personal animus with which Donald Trump is viewed in official Iranian circles.
sentences.zh: 该广告牌以英文承诺： “我们将杀死特朗普” –提升了唐纳德·特朗普在伊朗官方圈子中的个人敌意程度。

sentences.en: The poster depicts the US president behind bars with his head bowed.
sentences.zh: 这张海报描绘了美国总统在监狱里低着头。

sentences.en: And in a sense, given the US midterm election results on Tuesday, Iran has indeed killed Trump, or at least the second term of his presidency.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，鉴于美国周二的中期选举结果，伊朗确实已经杀死了特朗普，或者至少杀死了他的第二个总统任期。

sentences.en: Trump’s reverse is all the more piquant because it comes on the day Iran’s leadership celebrates the anniversary of the seizure of the US embassy in Tehran in 1979, an event that ensnared Jimmy Carter, and a reminder of how Iran has ruined the prospects of more than one US president.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的反面更加激烈，因为它发生在伊朗领导人庆祝1979年美国驻德黑兰大使馆被扣押的周年纪念日，这一事件使吉米·卡特陷入困境，并提醒人们伊朗如何破坏了不止一位美国总统的前景。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections

sentences.en: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 从美国中期选举中您需要了解的一切。

sentences.en: Democrats secured some big wins - and a few historic firsts - earning congratulations from President Trump.
sentences.zh: 民主党人取得了一些重大胜利，并取得了一些历史性的第一，赢得了特朗普总统的祝贺。

items.title: See the agents, set the terms: new visibility and control for personal agents

sentences.en: See the agents, set the terms: new visibility and control for personal agents.
sentences.zh: 查看代理，设置条款：为个人代理提供新的可见性和控制。

sentences.en: Personal agents are the intermediary between humans and the Internet, turning a person’s instructions into requests and actions on websites.
sentences.zh: 个人代理是人与互联网之间的中介，将人的指令转化为网站上的请求和行动。

sentences.en: A customer might ask a personal agent to compare products across your site, find support articles, or complete a purchase.
sentences.zh: 客户可能会要求个人代理比较您网站上的产品、查找支持文章或完成购买。

sentences.en: To a site owner, all three interactions show up as automated traffic — and without a clear view of which agents are visiting and what they are doing, it can be difficult to know whether that traffic is helping your business or creating risk.
sentences.zh: 对于站点所有者来说，这三种交互都显示为自动流量，如果没有清楚地了解哪些代理正在访问以及他们在做什么，就很难知道这些流量是有助于您的业务还是会带来风险。

sentences.en: Blocking agents altogether can feel like the safest choice, but it can mean losing customers.
sentences.zh: 完全屏蔽客服代表可能是最安全的选择，但这可能意味着失去客户。

sentences.en: Better visibility into agent activity allows you to decide what access makes sense for your site.
sentences.zh: 通过更好地了解代理活动，您可以决定哪些访问权限对您的站点有意义。

sentences.en: Today, we’re launching new analytics to help you understand how personal agents access your site on behalf of humans, along with more granular access policies to put those decisions into practice.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将推出新的分析功能，帮助您了解个人代理如何代表人类访问您的网站，并制定更精细的访问策略，将这些决策付诸实践。

sentences.en: Together, they let you welcome agents on your own terms, and in ways that support your business.
sentences.zh: 他们一起让您以自己的方式迎接客服代表，并以支持您业务的方式迎接客服代表。

sentences.en: See how agents access your site Knowing which agent is behind a request turns unexplained automated traffic into traffic you can act on with confidence.
sentences.zh: 了解客服代表访问您网站的方式了解请求背后的客服代表将无法解释的自动流量转化为您可以放心操作的流量。

sentences.en: Cloudflare maintains the largest verified bot directory in the world, and we are now bringing that intelligence into your traffic details.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare维护着世界上最大的已验证机器人目录，我们现在正在将这些智能引入您的流量详细信息中。

sentences.en: In Security Analytics, the Bot Analysis chart now shows Personal Assistants as a new category, next to Verified Bot, Likely Human, Likely Automated, and Automated.
sentences.zh: 在安全分析中， “机器人分析”图表现在将“个人助理”显示为新类别，仅次于“已验证机器人”、“可能是人”、“可能是自动化”和“自动化”。

sentences.en: Security teams can select it to see only personal agent traffic over time.
sentences.zh: 安全团队可以选择此选项，以随时间推移仅查看个人代理流量。

items.title: We're sharing our framework for building safer and more helpful AI for health.

sentences.en: We're sharing our framework for building safer and more helpful AI for health.
sentences.zh: 我们正在分享我们的框架，以构建更安全、更有用的健康人工智能。

sentences.en: Many of us have turned to AI with a health question or received care from a doctor who’s using it.
sentences.zh: 我们中的许多人都因健康问题而求助于人工智能，或者接受了使用它的医生的护理。

sentences.en: The adoption of technology for health is accelerating and impacts bill…
sentences.zh: 卫生技术的采用正在加速，并影响法案……

items.title: Nadal set to join Real Madrid board of directors

sentences.en: Nadal set to join Real Madrid board of directors.
sentences.zh: 纳达尔将加入皇家马德里董事会。

sentences.en: Tennis great Rafael Nadal is set to join the board of Spanish football giants Real Madrid.
sentences.zh: 网球巨星拉斐尔·纳达尔（ Rafael Nadal ）将加入西班牙足球巨头皇家马德里的董事会。

items.title: Israel’s election commission rejects Netanyahu claims of voting fraud

sentences.en: Israel’s election commission rejects Netanyahu claims of voting fraud.
sentences.zh: 以色列选举委员会驳回了内塔尼亚胡关于选举舞弊的指控。

sentences.en: Move comes after attorney general blocks Shin Bet call to interrogate politicians from Palestinian-led parties Israel’s election commission on Wednesday confirmed the final results of last week’s vote that stripped Benjamin Netanyahu’s far-right coalition of its governing majority, rejecting claims of mass fraud promoted by the prime minister.
sentences.zh: 在总检察长阻止辛贝特呼吁审问巴勒斯坦领导的政党以色列选举委员会的政治家之后，周三证实了上周投票的最终结果，该投票剥夺了本雅明内塔尼亚胡的极右翼执政联盟，拒绝了由总理推动的大规模欺诈指控。

sentences.en: The main challenger, Gadi Eisenkot, said Netanyahu had launched a “pogrom against democracy” in attempting to hold on to power by discrediting valid votes and weaponising security forces against parties led by Palestinian citizens of Israel.
sentences.zh: 主要挑战者加迪·艾森科特（ Gadi Eisenkot ）表示，内塔尼亚胡发起了“反民主的大屠杀” ，试图通过诋毁有效选票和将安全部队武器化来对抗由以色列巴勒斯坦公民领导的政党来保持权力。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: ‘The world is not ready’: Climate adaptation cash falls far short as warming heads past 1.5°C

sentences.en: ‘The world is not ready’: Climate adaptation cash falls far short as warming heads past 1.5°C.
sentences.zh: “世界还没有准备好” ：随着气候变暖超过1.5摄氏度，气候适应资金远远不足。

sentences.en: Although global warming is set to exceed 1.5°C, financing to help communities adapt to climate change falls far short of needs, the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) said in a report published on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 联合国环境规划署（ UNEP ）在周三发布的一份报告中表示，尽管全球变暖将超过1.5°C ，但帮助社区适应气候变化的资金远远不足以满足需求。

items.title: Afghan children face narrowing path to education, UN agencies report

sentences.en: Afghan children face narrowing path to education, UN agencies report.
sentences.zh: 联合国机构报告称，阿富汗儿童接受教育的途径越来越窄。

sentences.en: More than half of Afghanistan’s children who should be in primary school remain outside formal learning and millions of girls can only dream of going to university.
sentences.zh: 应该上小学的阿富汗儿童中有一半以上仍未接受正规教育，数百万女孩只能梦想上大学。

items.title: 15 years of ‘almost no progress’ in getting young people moving: WHO

sentences.en: 15 years of ‘almost no progress’ in getting young people moving: WHO.
sentences.zh: 15年来，在让年轻人搬家方面“几乎没有进展” ：世界卫生组织。

sentences.en: One in four adolescents worldwide reported not getting at least 60 minutes of physical activity on any day in the previous week, according to new global estimates released by the World Health Organization (WHO) on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 根据世界卫生组织（ WHO ）周三发布的最新全球估计，全球四分之一的青少年报告说，前一周的任何一天都没有至少60分钟的身体活动。

items.title: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers

sentences.en: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚的无证儿童为战争和一项将母亲拒之门外的法律“付出了代价”。

sentences.en: Many children born in Syria since the war began in 2011 have no legal identity because nationality passes only through fathers – many of whom are dead or missing – a member of the independent UN commission investigating rights violations in the country said on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 调查叙利亚侵犯人权行为的独立联合国委员会成员周三表示，自2011年战争开始以来，许多在叙利亚出生的儿童没有合法身份，因为国籍只通过父亲传递，其中许多人已经死亡或失踪。

items.title: Fuel price shock: Why developing economies are paying the most at the pump

sentences.en: Fuel price shock: Why developing economies are paying the most at the pump.
sentences.zh: 燃油价格冲击：为什么发展中经济体在油价上付出最大的代价。

sentences.en: When war shut the Strait of Hormuz in February, oil prices soared everywhere.
sentences.zh: 当战争在2月份关闭霍尔木兹海峡时，油价在各地飙升。

sentences.en: But the pain at the pump has been far from equal, and the world’s developing economies are paying the heaviest price, according to a new report from UNCTAD, the UN trade and development agency.
sentences.zh: 但根据联合国贸易和发展机构联合国贸易和发展会议（ UNCTAD ）的一份新报告，泵的痛苦远未达到平等，世界上的发展中经济体正在付出最沉重的代价。

items.title: Gunfire damages tents at Rafah displacement site in Gaza, as aid teams prepare for winter storms

sentences.en: Gunfire damages tents at Rafah displacement site in Gaza, as aid teams prepare for winter storms.
sentences.zh: 在救援队准备应对冬季风暴之际，枪声摧毁了加沙拉法流离失所者营地的帐篷。

sentences.en: Gunfire hit and damaged multiple tents at a displacement site in Gaza’s northern Rafah region on Tuesday, reportedly causing injuries and forcing a humanitarian partner to leave the area, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) has said.
sentences.zh: 联合国援助协调办公室（ OCHA ）表示，周二，在加沙北部拉法地区的一个流离失所地点，枪声击中并损坏了多个帐篷，据称造成人员受伤，并迫使人道主义合作伙伴离开该地区。

items.title: UN peacekeeping chief warns of ‘security vacuum’ as Blue Helmets leave Lebanon and Western Sahara

sentences.en: UN peacekeeping chief warns of ‘security vacuum’ as Blue Helmets leave Lebanon and Western Sahara.
sentences.zh: 联合国维和行动负责人警告称，随着蓝盔部队离开黎巴嫩和西撒哈拉，将出现“安全真空”。

sentences.en: The UN’s peacekeeping chief warned on Wednesday that the withdrawal of “Blue Helmets” from Lebanon and Western Sahara risks leaving a dangerous security vacuum, while the Security Council remains divided over what, if anything, should replace them.
sentences.zh: 联合国维持和平行动负责人周三警告说，从黎巴嫩和西撒哈拉撤出“蓝盔部队”可能会留下危险的安全真空，而安理会在应该用什么来取代他们的问题上仍然存在分歧。

items.title: COP31 explained: What’s at stake at this year’s UN climate summit?

sentences.en: COP31 explained: What’s at stake at this year’s UN climate summit?.
sentences.zh: COP31解释说：今年的联合国气候峰会有什么利害关系？

sentences.en: The world has more tools than ever to tackle climate change, yet millions remain unable to benefit from them.
sentences.zh: 世界上应对气候变化的工具比以往任何时候都多，但仍有数百万人无法从中受益。

sentences.en: As clean energy technologies advance faster than ever, the challenge facing countries at COP31 is no longer just finding solutions – but making sure everyone can afford them.
sentences.zh: 随着清洁能源技术比以往任何时候都更快地发展，各国在COP31上面临的挑战不再仅仅是寻找解决方案，而是确保每个人都能负担得起。

items.title: Take a closer look at art with the Courtauld

sentences.zh: 通过Google Arts & Culture和Courtauld艺术学院的新项目The Art of Looking以全新方式审视艺术。

sentences.zh: 查看显示美国如何在美国中期选举中投票的地图和图表。

items.title: Tears, celebrations and selfies: US midterms in pictures

sentences.en: Tears, celebrations and selfies: US midterms in pictures.
sentences.zh: 眼泪、庆祝活动和自拍：图片中的美国期中考试。

sentences.en: Democrats cheered as they picked up victories in Republican states.
sentences.zh: 民主党人在共和党各州取得胜利时欢呼雀跃。

sentences.en: Tears were shed as Republican losses mounted.
sentences.zh: 随着共和党损失的增加，人们流下了眼泪。

items.title: Anthony Zurcher: Democrats push deep into Trump heartland on historic night

sentences.en: Anthony Zurcher: Democrats push deep into Trump heartland on historic night.
sentences.zh: Anthony Zurcher ：民主党在历史性的夜晚深入特朗普的心脏地带。

sentences.en: Two Senate races that a year ago were thought to be battlegrounds turned out to be slam-dunks for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 一年前被认为是战场的两场参议院竞选被证明是民主党的扣篮。

items.title: 'I'm not a quitter': Kim Kardashian on retaking the bar exam

sentences.en: 'I'm not a quitter': Kim Kardashian on retaking the bar exam.
sentences.zh: “我不是一个放弃者” ： Kim Kardashian重新参加律师考试。

sentences.en: The All's Fair star tells the BBC she has not given up, but will be "more quiet" about her journey to become a lawyer.
sentences.zh: All's Fair明星告诉英国广播公司，她没有放弃，但对她成为律师的旅程将“更加安静”。

items.title: One dead and another missing in suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada

sentences.en: One dead and another missing in suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada.
sentences.zh: 在加拿大疑似灰熊袭击中，一人死亡，另一人失踪。

sentences.en: The incident took place in the same province where a grizzly attacked a group of schoolchildren last November A mother is dead and her daughter is missing in western Canada after a suspected grizzly bear attack in the same community where a bear attacked a group of schoolchildren earlier in the year.
sentences.zh: 这起事件发生在同一省份，去年11月，一只灰熊袭击了一群学童。今年早些时候，一只灰熊袭击了一群学童。在加拿大西部，一只可疑的灰熊袭击了该社区，导致一名母亲死亡，她的女儿失踪。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the British Columbia conservation officer service said in a social media post that it had launched a search for the two missing people on the weekend, and that during the search on Sunday an officer found the mother’s body.
sentences.zh: 周二，不列颠哥伦比亚省保护官员服务部门在一篇社交媒体帖子中表示，他们已经在周末开始寻找两名失踪人员，在周日的搜索中，一名官员发现了母亲的尸体。

sentences.en: The search for her 19-year-old daughter is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 正在寻找她19岁的女儿。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Trump claims US will end military aid to Israel by end of this year

sentences.en: Trump claims US will end military aid to Israel by end of this year.
sentences.zh: 特朗普声称美国将在今年年底前结束对以色列的军事援助。

sentences.en: US president makes surprise election day announcement, saying country does not ‘need’ $4bn annual payment Donald Trump has said that the US will end military aid to Israel at the end of this year in a surprise election day announcement that appeared to be targeted at voters sceptical of US support for Israel and the war in Gaza .
sentences.zh: 美国总统突然宣布选举日，称该国“不需要”每年40亿美元的付款唐纳德·特朗普曾表示，美国将在今年年底突然宣布选举日结束对以色列的军事援助，这似乎是针对那些对美国支持以色列和加沙战争持怀疑态度的选民。

sentences.en: In a phone interview with Fox News as voting began on Tuesday morning, the US president said the US would cut nearly $4bn (£2.96bn) in military aid to Israel because “they don’t need it”.
sentences.zh: 在周二上午投票开始之际，这位美国总统在接受福克斯新闻电话采访时表示，美国将削减对以色列近40亿美元（ 29.6亿英镑）的军事援助，因为“他们不需要”。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world

sentences.en: Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world.
sentences.zh: 阿尼斯将地球上的任何地方都变成了我的世界。

sentences.en: Louis Erbkamm knows his way around Arnis, the smallest town in Germany, but he s never set foot in it.
sentences.zh: 路易斯·埃尔布坎姆（ Louis Erbkamm ）知道自己在德国最小的城镇阿尼斯（ Arnis ）周围的路线，但他从未踏

sentences.en: I know where the shops are.
sentences.zh: 我知道商店在哪里。

sentences.en: Where the boats are I know the city pretty well, but I haven t been there yet.
sentences.zh: 船在哪里，我对这座城市非常熟悉，但我还没有去过那里。

sentences.en: Louis Erbkamm, maintainer of Arnis Arnis is also the name of his open source project, which takes real-world data from OpenStreetMap and other sources to turn places you know into Minecraft worlds you can freely explore.
sentences.zh: Arnis Arnis的维护者Louis Erbkamm也是他的开源项目的名字，该项目从OpenStreetMap和其他来源获取真实世界的数据，将您知道的地方变成您可以自由探索的Minecraft世界。

sentences.en: Since Louis started Arnis in 2022, it s reached close to 900,000 downloads from GitHub and about 70 contributors.
sentences.zh: 自从Louis在2022年创立Arnis以来，它从GitHub下载了近90万次，约有70名贡献者。

sentences.en: Two weeks and a slow prototype Louis grew up playing Minecraft and started coding at 13, always looking for ways to bring code into the game.
sentences.zh: 两周后，一个缓慢的原型Louis在玩Minecraft时长大，从13岁开始编码，一直在寻找将代码带入游戏的方法。

sentences.en: Arnis began as a fun diversion combining Minecraft with geospatial data, and it went on GitHub, where he already kept his side projects.
sentences.zh: Arnis最初是将Minecraft与地理空间数据相结合的一个有趣的转移，后来在GitHub上进行，他已经在那里保存了他的侧面项目。

sentences.en: He finished the first prototype within two weeks while on a break from school.
sentences.zh: 他在放学休息的两周内完成了第一个原型。

sentences.en: That first version was Python written by hand, built only on OpenStreetMap, and generating a town took a while.
sentences.zh: 第一个版本是手工编写的Python ，仅在OpenStreetMap上构建，生成一个城镇需要一段时间。

sentences.en: He needed somewhere real to test it, so he looked up towns in Germany, where he lives, and found Arnis.
sentences.zh: 他需要一个真正的地方来测试它，所以他寻找他居住的德国城镇，并找到了阿尼斯。

sentences.en: A small town helped while early generation was slow.
sentences.zh: 一个小镇帮助了，而早期的一代人却很慢。
